info.name: Expedia Group EPS Bookings Deposit API

description.content:
The EPS Deposit API manages the deposit policy for a property, offering operations to create/update, read and delete it.

To start experimenting, please use your existing EQC credentials and properties. We've also made the following test credentials available: EQCtest12933870 / ew67nk33 assigned to test property ID 12933870. Contact Support: Name: Expedia Partner Services Email: eqcss@expedia.com
